title: Stabilo and Kiko turn the iconic Boss Mini highlighter into a lip marker
summary: Stabilo and Kiko Milano have joined forces to launch a limited-edition lip collection inspired by the design of the Stabilo Boss Mini highlighter. In a playful twist, the iconic highlighter swaps the pencil case for the make-up bag, bringing a fresh splash of colour to the beauty aisle. Launched on 5 November 2026, the Stabilo x Kiko Milano Lip Marker collection comprises five lip shades with playful names inspired by writing and personal expression: Fine Print, Afterthought, Don't Quote... - Industry buzz
